name: HOMIO Autonomous Build + Runtime Integration Master Plan

authority.continuity_authority: ACRL derived from canonical machine state
authority.rule: This plan may guide execution but may never override canonical state, approved architecture, or controller rules.

mission.primary: Build HOMIO/REOS so the autonomous system helps build HOMIO and the same proven autonomy stack later operates HOMIO in production.
not_allowed: Do not create a second autonomy product.
Do not create a second roadmap authority.
Do not create a second state authority.
Do not replace REOS_CONTROL_CENTER as execution authority.
Do not mix Imperium AI into HOMIO/REOS.

north_star: Protect lead ownership and deal ownership.
Deliver a secure, auditable, resilient, multi-tenant Real Estate Operating System.

REOS_CONTROL_CENTER.role: Authoritative control plane and state machine.

AUTONOMY_ENGINE.role: Autonomous engineering and runtime intelligence layer.

ACRL.role: Continuity, reconstruction, repository intelligence, evidence, recovery, dependency and reconciliation capability layer.
ACRL.status: Use the existing T01-T30 spine; do not create numbered work merely to extend the sequence.
capabilities: intelligent test selection and failure diagnosis

HOMIO.role: Actual business/product/domain system and eventual production runtime.

HOMIO_BUILDER.purpose: Use the autonomous system to safely build HOMIO.
loop: Check frozen architecture, contracts and acceptance criteria.
Execute only through the authorized execution boundary.
Continue only when the next action is safe and authoritative.

HOMIO_RUNTIME.purpose: Use the same proven autonomy capabilities to operate HOMIO after deployment.

promotion_rule: A build-time autonomy capability may become production runtime capability only after it is machine-tested, evidence-backed, fail-closed, auditable, and compatible with HOMIO governance and human approval boundaries.

phases.name: Canonical Authority Reconciliation
phases.goal: Remove authority ambiguity before expanding autonomous behavior.
actions: Trace all references to REOS_CONTROL_CENTER/data/state.json.
Trace competing state artifacts such as root reos_state.json.
Trace all gate-template sources and fallback templates.
Trace PROJECT_CONTINUITY and ACRL continuity usage.
Reconcile old AUTONOMY_ENGINE naming/documentation references.
Retire or mark compatibility artifacts only after reference and semantic verification.
exit_criteria: One canonical execution state is proven.

phases.name: Autonomous Engineering Loop Activation
phases.goal: Bind existing Control Center, AUTONOMY_ENGINE and ACRL into one safe builder loop.
actions: Load and integrity-check canonical state.
Build compact execution context through ACRL.
Resolve current gate/task/subtask from authority.
Use repository and dependency intelligence to identify required evidence and tests.
Create a bounded action proposal.
Pass the proposal through policy, risk, authorization, guard and idempotency checks.
Execute through the existing ControllerExecutor/ExecutionPipeline boundary.
Verify postflight state and evidence.
Checkpoint and produce resumable handoff data.
exit_criteria: A fresh session can reconstruct the real project position without chat memory.
The system can identify authoritative next work.
The system can execute one controlled Control Center mutation through the real execution boundary.
Postflight verification proves canonical state integrity.

phases.name: HOMIO Autonomous Build
phases.goal: Use the activated autonomy loop to build the remaining authoritative HOMIO domains.
phases.rule: Follow REOS_CONTROL_CENTER/data/state.json for the real current gate sequence. Do not invent a parallel roadmap.
exit_criteria: All required HOMIO gates are completed by the authoritative Control Center.
Evidence and checkpoints exist for completed work.
No unresolved architecture or authority drift remains.

phases.name: HOMIO Production Runtime Promotion
phases.goal: Promote proven autonomy capabilities into HOMIO production operations.
actions: Reuse the same governance, policy, evidence, risk and approval boundaries.
Bind production events/workflows to autonomous observation and reasoning.
Keep irreversible high-risk actions human-approved.
Implement production monitoring, audit, recovery and escalation.
Use staged rollout and rollback controls.
exit_criteria: Production autonomy can observe, reason, govern, execute and verify safely.
Human approval boundaries are technically enforced.
Every autonomous production action is auditable.

phases.name: Self-Maintaining HOMIO / REOS
phases.goal: Continuously protect and improve HOMIO without uncontrolled autonomy.
exit_criteria: The system can resume from canonical state after interruption.

do_not: Do not create ACRL T31 simply because T01-T30 exists.
Do not restart already-proven T01-T30 work without evidence of regression.
Do not replace the existing operational runtime with a parallel runtime.
use: Treat T01-T30 as an existing verified capability spine.
Integrate and activate existing capability before adding new capability.
Extend ACRL only when a real HOMIO requirement is identified and canonical state authorizes it.

after_action: Re-read state before selecting the next action.

stop_conditions: security or governance boundary is unclear
resume_protocol: Read current gate/task/subtask from machine state.
Use ACRL to reconstruct only the context required for that task.
Inspect the repository evidence required by the task.
Continue from the first incomplete authoritative unit.
Never restart completed work merely because a new chat/session started.
success_definition: HOMIO is built with the help of an autonomous engineering system and, after deployment, operates with the same proven autonomous architecture. The autonomy layer does not replace the Control Center; it makes the Control Center context-aware, evidence-driven and safely executable.
golden_execution_rule: DISCOVER -> VERIFY -> UNDERSTAND -> RESEARCH -> DESIGN -> RED-TEAM -> EXECUTE -> VERIFY RESULT -> RECORD -> CHECKPOINT -> CONTINUE
next_action_rule: At every point, compute the next safe action from canonical machine state plus verified repository evidence. If this cannot be done safely, stop and request targeted evidence or human approval.
